source.title: spec(automation): token-wallet v3 -- the TRINET 1:1:1 split, provider / fund / first-line referrer
source.body:
The owner set the TRINET payment formula on 2026-11-02: a client pays 3 units for a service, and
the 3 units split 1 + 1 + 1:

| Unit | Goes to |
|------|---------|
| 1 | the PROVIDER: whoever supplies the service (a model provider or any TRINET supplier) |
| 2 | the FUND: creators, .t27 developers, builders of the system, network operations and reserves |
| 3 | the REFERRER on the first line only: the one person the client came from |

The three-unit trade already exists as an owner decision of 2026-10-23 in the token wallet spec
(TRADE_UNITS 3, SHARE_HOUSE, SHARE_BOUNTY, SHARE_REFERRAL). This issue records the new wording
there as v3 instead of writing a second spec: slot 1 becomes the provider (for the bot it is
still the house, so its economics do not move), slot 2 becomes the fund (the old bounty pool,
widened), and the referrer is limited to the first line. No host imports the old SHARE_* names
(checked in this repo and in 999-multibots-telegraf).

Defaults taken until the owner decides (not owner rules):
- a client with no referrer leaves unit 3 HELD and paid to nobody; sending it to the fund was
  suggested but not decided;
- the split is unit-blind; the owner names the TRINET unit $TRI, but the spec never prices,
  promises or mints $TRI, and nothing moves in $TRI while the service ledger keeps TRI_PAYABLE
  false.

Open owner items, not part of this issue: the fund's internal budget, refunds of a service not
delivered, where the 3 units come from, what a unit is worth, how the 1:1:1 split relates to the
job-pool split in the network pool spec, and the ad-viewer reward budget (a separate budget,
never split by this formula).

The edit makes the token wallet seal stale; a re-save needs a post-10-27 t27c in a T27 OS pane.

## Boundary

- specs/automation/token-wallet.t27
- .trinity/seals/automation_automation::token_wallet.json

## User Scenarios

- **Given** a client with a direct referrer pays 24 units, **when** the split runs, **then** the provider, the fund and the referrer each get 8.
- **Given** a client who came from nobody pays 24 units, **when** the split runs, **then** the provider and the fund each get 8 and 8 is held, paid to nobody.
- **Given** a referrer two lines above the client, **when** the split runs, **then** that person gets nothing.

## Requirements

- FR-001: The spec MUST name the three shares SHARE_PROVIDER, SHARE_FUND and SHARE_REFERRAL, 1 unit each of TRADE_UNITS 3.
- FR-002: The spec MUST pay the referral share to line 1 only (REFERRAL_DEPTH 1).
- FR-003: With no referrer the spec MUST hold unit 3 and pay it to nobody; paid plus held MUST equal the referral share.
- FR-004: The spec MUST NOT price, promise or mint $TRI.
- FR-005: The seal MUST be re-saved by a post-10-27 t27c before merge.

## Success Criteria

- All 13 tests of the token wallet spec pass, 0 fail.
- `git diff --stat origin/master` touches 2 files: the spec and its seal json.
- The seal check exits 0 (`exit 0`).
